units.source_text: 源氏公子正在烦恼之际，天忽降下小雨，

en.t: Just as Prince Genji was sunk in distress, a light rain suddenly began to fall,

units.source_text: 山风吹来，寒气逼人，瀑布的声音也响起来了。

en.t: a mountain wind blew in, the chill pressed close, and the sound of the waterfall began to echo as well.

units.source_text: 其中夹着断断续续的诵经声，其声含糊而凄凉。

en.t: Mixed in with it were broken snatches of sutra chanting, faint and mournful in sound.

units.source_text: 即使是冥顽不灵之人，处此境地亦不免悲伤，

en.t: Even a dull and unfeeling person, placed in such a scene, could hardly avoid sadness,

units.source_text: 何况多情善感的源氏公子。

en.t: much less the tender and sensitive Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 他左思右想，愁绪万斛，不能成眠。

en.t: He turned matters over again and again, overwhelmed by sorrow, and could not fall asleep.

units.source_text: 僧都说初夜诵经，其实夜已很深。

en.t: The bishop had called it the first evening chanting, but in truth the night was already far advanced.

units.source_text: 内屋里的妇女分明尚未就寝。

en.t: The women in the inner room were plainly not yet asleep.

units.source_text: 她们虽然行动小心谨慎，但是念珠接触矮几之声[\[11\]](#part1334.html#m11)隐约可闻。

en.t: Although they moved with great care, the sound of prayer beads brushing against a low table could be faintly heard.

units.source_text: 听到衣衫窸窣之声，更觉得优雅可亲。

en.t: Hearing the soft rustle of their robes made them seem all the more graceful and endearing.

units.source_text: 房间相去不远。

en.t: The rooms were not far apart.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便悄悄地走到这房间门前，

en.t: Prince Genji therefore quietly went to the doorway of that room,

units.source_text: 将围在外面的屏风稍稍推开，拍响扇子，表示招呼。

en.t: pushed the surrounding screen slightly aside, and tapped his fan to announce himself.

units.source_text: 里面的人料想不到，但也不便置若罔闻，

en.t: Those inside had not expected this, but they could not very well pretend not to have heard,

units.source_text: 便有一个侍女膝行[\[12\]](#part1334.html#m12)而前。

en.t: so one attendant woman moved forward on her knees.

units.source_text: 到得门口，又倒退两步，惊诧地说：“咦！

en.t: When she reached the doorway, she backed away two steps and said in surprise, "Oh!

units.source_text: 怪哉，我听错了吧。”

en.t: How strange, perhaps I heard wrong."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“有佛菩萨引导，即使暗中也不会走错。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "With the Buddha and bodhisattvas to guide one, even in the dark one will not lose the way."

units.source_text: 这声音多么温柔优雅！

en.t: How gentle and elegant that voice was!

units.source_text: 那侍女觉得自己的声音相形见绌，不敢回话了。

en.t: The attendant felt her own voice was poor by comparison and no longer dared to answer.

units.source_text: 终于答道：“请问公子欲见何人，幸蒙开示。”

en.t: At last she replied, "May I ask whom Your Grace wishes to see? Please be so kind as to tell me."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“今日之事，过分唐突，难怪你惊诧。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "What has happened today is far too abrupt, so it is no wonder that you are startled.

units.source_text: 须知：

en.t: But you must know this:
